comments.author: @PrimeTravel2
comments.text: Florida is often portrayed as a tropical paradise, but every place has another side that visitors rarely notice. I really enjoy documentaries that look beyond the postcard image!

comments.author: @travelintolifeus
comments.text: I've always thought of Florida as a vacation destination, but seeing the everyday struggles and routines of local families gives me a completely different perspective. From small fishing communities to busy cities, this state has so many stories that tourists often miss. This is the Florida I wanted to see!
